御月民 -OTSUKIMI- is, as its name suggests, an outdoor festival timed to coincide with the harvest moon. For its seventh edition in 2026, the setting is Healing Garden Takanami, on the shores of Lake Takanami at the northern tip of the Northern Alps in Itoigawa, Niigata. Sixteen acts from Japan and abroad will carry the three days through.

artists/kyomi.html: Kyomi (鏡民) is a Tokyo-based DJ who plays parties all over Japan. Experimental, genre-blind selections drive sets that are as exploratory as they are fun to dance to. WOMB and Mitsuki are the most frequent Tokyo stops, and August 2026 brought a date at Pawnshop in Taipei.
artists/suimin.html: Suimin is a Tokyo DJ who turns up again and again at Bonobo's 渦 (Uzu) nights alongside 空中水泳, as well as FREEDOM無国籍HOUR at Débris and MAMACULT at Bonobo. Outdoors, Suimin has played rural in both 2023 and 2026.
artists/tsutomu.html: A DJ and the producer of Sawagi Festival. He also sits on the organizing committee of Spring Love 春風, held in Yoyogi Park, giving him another face as a builder of festivals. He is someone who has kept one foot on each side: the person putting the records on, and the person opening the doors.
festivals/prox.html: PROX is a music festival running from midday through to the following morning at DAN OISO, a site in Oiso, Kanagawa, born out of a renovated farm plot. After a daytime run of live sets, the focus shifts at 23:00 to the covered arch-shaped stage, where DJs take over. SUNGA, Dazzle Drums, カワムラユキ and others link up the sounds as the dancing carries on until 5 a.m. Come to camp, or just turn up for the night. On land that was once farmland, it's a single night where music, place and different scenes intersect.
